counterfactual_text: The intact ice cube is suddenly replaced by a finished puddle covering the same plate area.
positive_text: The same ice cube becomes progressively smaller as liquid water spreads outward in a growing puddle on the plate.
semantic_text: A clear ice cube on a shallow plate gradually shrinks while a puddle of water grows around it. Required visible entities: one clear ice cube; one shallow plate; exposed plate area around the cube. At the beginning: ice cube: intact, clearly bounded, and near full initial size; plate: shallow with a dry exposed surface around the ice. Required state changes: ice visible size: large to progressively smaller; ice boundary: sharp to receding; water area: minimal to progressively larger. These event variables are allowed to change: ice-cube size and boundary; solid fraction and visible ice presence; liquid-water area on the plate. Preserve throughout: static close camera; plate identity and position; background and lighting; one clear ice cube and its resulting water; one shallow plate; the same material system and camera view.
